desc: Parse N, X and group foods by V_i into three lists of (A_i, C_i).
If any of vitamins 1,2,3 has no foods, answer is 0.
For each vitamin compute best_v[c] = max amount with at most c calories via 0/1 knapsack over calories (vectorized numpy with pure-Python fallback), with prefix max to enforce monotonicity.
Binary search largest feasible T in [0, hi], hi = min over nonempty vitamins of sum of A_i; feasibility(T) sums lower-bound search of best_v for T per vitamin, returning infeasible if best_v[X] < T.
